statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has a history of supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1)
A 48-hour Holter monitoring study, CPT 93226, was billed
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that the service is not covered under the patient's current benefit plan
The 48-hour Holter monitor is ordered to evaluate for intermittent arrhythmias or ischemic changes contributing to symptomatic events
